_notes.bot_phone: The bot's WhatsApp number with country code. Optional (BOT_PHONE works too); onboard then prints each broker's start link.
_notes.lang: Per broker: ar (default) or en. The bot replies, the website and the start link (مساعدة / help) follow it; each broker can change it later on the website (عربي / English).
_notes.code_prefix: Optional, 1 to 4 Latin letters: units added without a code get <letters>-<type letter><number>, e.g. PA-V12. Default: the agency's initials.
_notes.role: broker, agent, admin, owner or manager. At least one admin, owner or manager.
